fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records carry headline/articleBody-style fields (S1-jsonld -- full articleBody inline in the NewsArticle ld+json node, most sections; S2-html -- HTML-scraped body from div.story-body, evewoman section only); latest-mode records (S2-sitemap, Google News sitemap at /sitemaps/googlenews.php) carry title/link-style fields.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record: S1-jsonld, S2-html, or S2-sitemap.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (e.g. "not_found", "http_500", "blocked_or_transient").

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

articleId.title: Article ID
articleId.description: Internal numeric article ID, taken from the /article/<id>/ URL path segment.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the NewsArticle ld+json node.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article summary, from the NewsArticle ld+json node (present on some sections, e.g. evewoman; absent on others).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text. On S1-jsonld records this is the ld+json articleBody, double html-entity-unescaped (see CRAWLING_METHOD.md). On S2-html records (evewoman section only) this is reconstructed from

tags inside div.story-body with ads/scripts stripped.

articleSection.title: Article section (raw)
articleSection.description: Raw articleSection list from ld+json, e.g. ["Crime and Justice"].

category.title: Category
category.description: First entry of articleSection, as a plain string convenience field.

author.title: Author
author.description: Raw author value from ld+json -- a list of Person objects on most sections, a single Person object on evewoman. Passed through as-is.

image.title: Image
image.description: Raw image value from ld+json -- a list of image URL strings on most sections, a single ImageObject on evewoman. Passed through as-is.

isAccessibleForFree.title: Is accessible for free
isAccessibleForFree.description: Piano-style paywall metadata flag from ld+json. Observed both true and false across sampled articles, but articleBody was NOT truncated in either case -- see CRAWLING_METHOD.md paywall verdict. Absent on some sections (e.g. evewoman).

canonicalUrl.title: Canonical URL
canonicalUrl.description: mainEntityOfPage (or @id) from ld+json -- sometimes differs from the input URL (e.g. evewoman article URLs canonicalize to include an extra subsection path segment).

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode sitemap item.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL from the sitemap item.

section.title: Section
section.description: First URL path segment (e.g. "national", "opinion", "crime-and-justice") -- latest mode only, derived from the article URL since the sitemap item itself carries no explicit category field.

publicationDate.title: Publication date
publicationDate.description: ISO 8601 publish date from the news:publication_date sitemap field -- latest mode only.

language.title: Language
language.description: ISO language code from the news:language sitemap field -- latest mode only.

lastmod.title: Last modified
lastmod.description: Date from the sitemap item's lastmod field -- latest mode only.

imageUrl.title: Image URL
imageUrl.description: Lead image URL from the sitemap item's image:loc field -- latest mode only.

imageCaption.title: Image caption
imageCaption.description: Lead image caption from the sitemap item's image:caption field -- latest mode only.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
